# Personalized AI birthday video with a song that sings their name

**A name, an age and a few photos become a 15–60 s video with their name sung and their photo coming to life.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_bd1ca2b38b14.webp" alt="A woman with curly hair blows out the candles on a &quot;Maya 30&quot; birthday cake surrounded by fairy lights, then laughs as friends film her." width="480"></p>

Turns a name, an age and a few photos into a personalized AI birthday video on varg: a song that sings their name, their photo coming to life as they blow out the candles, a "then and now" montage, an epic trailer starring them, a pet's birthday, an animated e-card or invitation. Asks the 5 questions that make it theirs, makes the stills first (GPT Image 2.5 spells the name on the cake), animates them (Wan 3, Seedance 2.5), makes the song (ElevenLabs Music sings the name), then exports one file that plays on WhatsApp and iMessage. Use when someone asks for a birthday video, a happy birthday message, a birthday song with a name, a birthday surprise, a video for a friend's, partner's, mom's or dad's birthday, a milestone birthday (18, 30, 50, 80), a pet's birthday or a birthday invitation. Not for weddings, anniversaries and holiday greetings (use varg-occasion-video) or a business sending birthday videos to every customer (make-personalized-videos-at-scale on varg how to).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-birthday-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-birthday-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 15–60 s MP4 for WhatsApp or TV |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.08–0.10 per name song, ~$1–3.40 per animated clip (tested) |
| Uses | varg API, GPT Image 2.5, Wan 3, Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, ElevenLabs Music, Whisper, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a birthday video for my mom Rita turning 60 from ./mom.jpg, with a song that sings her name"
- "Make a then-and-now birthday montage from the photos in ./photos/ for my friend's 30th"
- "Make a 15-second birthday video for my dog Biscuit in a party hat that I can send on WhatsApp"
